verdict.rationale: Lovable's own docs describe two built-in security scanners, Basic scan and Deep scan, plus optional connectors and scheduled Deep scans for enterprise, so the platform itself reviews the generated app for security issues. The evidence does not tie scanning to the publish flow, does not describe what the scanners detect, and has no hands-on corroboration, so the 'before it goes live' part is only implied. missing for 10: documented pre-publish scan gating or integration with publishing, details of scan coverage and findings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the platform review my generated app for security issues before it goes live

citations.quote: Lovable includes two built-in security scanners, Basic scan and Deep scan, plus optional connectors for additional coverage.
